scope: Focused media-free checks: 16 cases against new packaged public GStreamer libraries/plugins and one source-linked RTP helper regression; pre-install evidence.

check_runner.packaged_runtime_identity: Actual test-process loader traces verified separately from plugin-scanner traces for 16 cases. The one RTP capacity regression links the actual source helper and loads no candidate library.

scope: Opaque caller-owned RPU bytes are copied; shallow and deep buffer copies preserve ownership semantics.
Region copying drops picture-owned metadata; held GBytes outlives original buffers.
Wrapped buffer-memory finalizer runs once. This is not an RPU destroy callback.
Public profile-5/profile-8 decoder configuration accepts valid synthetic layouts, preserves unknown compatibility for a valid short record, and rejects truncated, oversized and reserved inputs.

rtp_capacity_boundary.implementation: Actual public gstrtpchannels.c helper linked by the regression target.
rtp_capacity_boundary.checks: Guarded prefix/suffix and capacity-limited writes. The Ubuntu fix permits unpositioned channels; rejection of every count above64 is not asserted.

limits: No codec decode or real media playback in this fast lane.
Synthetic opaque bytes are not evidence of a valid RPU payload.
No browser, compositor or desktop application launched by these checks.
No installation, optical calibration, every-frame/full-film acceptance or certification claim.
Focused cases are not the full GStreamer unit suite.
